candidates.question: Which objects are labelled PASS but have no receiver pickup?
candidates.bounded_probe: Enumerate a bounded candidate set of PASS claims and require exact elected-receiver readproof before classifying pickup.
candidates.negative_evidence: Every sampled PASS claim has exact elected-receiver pickup proof.
candidates.retirement_condition: Close for sampled scope when each object is either pickup-proven, downgraded, or explicitly out of scope.
candidates.decision_if_yes: Downgrade false completion claims and create exact pickup deeds.
candidates.decision_if_no: Retire this sneak candidate for the sampled scope.

candidates.question: Which tasks repeatedly require Rick to relay, refresh, approve, remember, or interpret state?
candidates.bounded_probe: Trace a bounded sample of current copy/paste, download, manual, and refresh references from text signal to receiver reference to live-use/currentness/successor evidence.
candidates.negative_evidence: Every sampled manuality signal is either historical-only, authority-required, superseded, or absent from current receiver routing.
candidates.retirement_condition: Close for sampled scope when every signal is classified RETIRE, KEEP_AUTHORITY_GATE, SUPERSEDED, or LIVE_AUTOMATION_DEBT.
candidates.decision_if_yes: Prioritize live automation debt that still creates human transport or refresh dependency.
candidates.decision_if_no: Retire stale manuality as a current blocker for the sampled scope.

candidates.question: Which proofs rely on the same failure domain while presenting as independent?
candidates.bounded_probe: Compare a bounded proof set by provider, credential root, host, site, and execution substrate rather than receiver count alone.
candidates.negative_evidence: All sampled independence claims bind distinct relevant failure domains.
candidates.retirement_condition: Close for sampled scope when every independence claim is either failure-domain-proven or downgraded.
candidates.decision_if_yes: Downgrade independence claims and route a diversity proof.
candidates.decision_if_no: Retire this sneak candidate for the sampled scope.

candidates.question: Which lane is generating artifacts faster than receivers can absorb them?
candidates.bounded_probe: Compare bounded emission and pickup counts for one candidate lane over one declared horizon.
candidates.negative_evidence: Pickup rate meets or exceeds emission rate over the sampled horizon.
candidates.retirement_condition: Close when the sampled lane has a calibrated emission-to-pickup ratio or insufficient telemetry is explicitly recorded.
candidates.decision_if_no: Keep current lane width for the sampled horizon.

candidates.question: Which recurring deed could be compiled into a local/open-model worker?
candidates.bounded_probe: Select one recurring advisory deed with an exact input/output contract and test it on an already-proven local/open route.
candidates.negative_evidence: No sampled recurring deed fits the proven local route within resource and quality bounds.
candidates.retirement_condition: Close for sampled scope after one deed is compiled and independently verified, or all sampled deeds fail explicit fit gates.
candidates.decision_if_yes: Reduce provider dependency for that deed.
candidates.decision_if_no: Preserve provider route while recording exact local blockers.

candidates.question: What proof, if obtained, would retire the largest number of open questions?
candidates.negative_evidence: No single proof dominates the current proof frontier.
candidates.retirement_condition: Requires an independently bounded proof candidate before this meta-question can become executable.

candidates.question: Where does capability masquerade as authority?
candidates.bounded_probe: Inspect a bounded authority edge set for capability-only claims used as effect authorization.
candidates.negative_evidence: No sampled effect edge relies on capability alone for authority.
candidates.retirement_condition: Close for sampled scope only after authority conflict is independently adjudicated.
candidates.decision_if_yes: HOLD affected effects and repair authority provenance.
